title: The interview hack that works every single time

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if one interview hack could change how we perceive AI's role in hiring and decision-making?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: AI-driven behavioral analysis now detects micro-expressions and tone shifts in real time during interviews.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But this risks reinforcing biases if training data reflects historical discrimination in hiring practices.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are using adversarial training and diverse data sets to reduce bias and improve fairness.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a future where AI helps identify potential, not just fit, by analyzing emotional intelligence and growth potential.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of hiring may lie in AI that evaluates character as deeply as capability.

video_cue: A diverse group of candidates interacting with an AI system that displays empathy and understanding.
